docs.title: S3
docs.text:
S3- Bucket names must be globally unique across all AWS accounts

SSE-S3 - Amazon manages keys (AES-256)

  • Header: x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256
  • SSE-S3 encrypt each file with different key

SSE-KMS - AWS Key Management Service

  • Header: x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms

SSE-C - Customer provided keys

  • You manage keys, AWS manages encryption
  • HTTPS required
  • Key must be provided with every request
  • x-amz-server-side-encryption-customer-algorithm: AES256
  • x-amz-server-side-encryption-customer-key: \<Base64-encoded key>
  • x-amz-server-side-encryption-customer-key-MD5: \<Base64-encoded MD5 hash>
  • Client-Side Encryption:
  • Encrypt data before uploading
  • You manage everything

Performance Multipart Upload: Required for files > 5GB Recommended for files > 100MB Parallel uploads for speed

docs.title: Minimum part size
docs.text:
• Each part must be at least 5 MB
  • Except the final part (can be smaller)
  • Max parts: 10,000 S3 Transfer accelerator: Uses cloudfront Increase transfer speed by transferring file to AWS edge location - good for global users FILE USA →Edge USA → S3 Australia

S3 Replication

Cross-Region Replication (CRR)

  • Replicate to different region
  • Use: compliance, lower latency, disaster recovery

Same-Region Replication (SRR)

Combine logs or data from multiple S3 buckets into a single bucket within the same region for centralized processing

Account-to-account replication - Copy data between different AWS accounts in the same region for organizational separation while maintaining low latency

  • Replicate within same region
  • Use: log aggregation, live replication between accounts
  • Like test and dev account

After you enable replication - only new object replicated

Existing one can be replicated with S3 Batch Replication

Deletion with version ID not replicable

STS:

  • On the production account, create an IAM role and specify the development account as a trusted entity.
  • Set the policy that will grant access to S3 for the IAM role created in the production account.
  • Log in to the development account and create a policy that will use STS to assume the IAM role in the production account. Attach the policy to the IAM users.

Amazon S3 - Security: User Based:

  • IAM policy - what api call is allowed for a specific user

Resource Based: Bucket Policy: json policy that allows :

  • Access to other account/ services
  • Force encryption on upload
  • Public access bucket

Object Access Control List: List of Permission that applies to a file Bucket Access Control list: A Bucket ACL is a list of permissions that applies to the bucket itself

GuardDuty: to detect anomalies with ML Use Amazon GuardDuty to monitor any malicious activity on data stored in Amazon S3.

Storage classes

Amazon S3 Standard - General Purpose:

  • Frequently used data
  • Low latency

Infrequent: Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (IA):

  • Less frequent data
  • But with rapid access
  • Backup Disaster recovery
  • Min 30 days you pay for
  • More costly then One Zone-IA

Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access

  • Less frequent data
  • But with rapid access
  • Single AZ so lost with AZ
  • Min 30 days you pay for

Glacier: Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval:

  • Low cost
  • Archiving
  • Ms retrieval
  • Once a quarter
  • Min storage 90 days

Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval:

  • Low cost
  • Archiving
  • Retrieval Expedited(1-5) Standard(3-5hrs) Bulk(5-12hr) retrieval
  • Min storage 90 days

Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive:c

  • Low cost
  • Archiving
  • Retrieval Standard(12 hours) bulk (48hr)
  • Min storage 180 days

Amazon S3 Intelligent Tiering

  • Moves automatically between tiers
  • No retrieval charges
  • Stays default → in 30 days not usage moves infrequent access tier → 90 days not usage moves archive instant access tier

Amazon S3 Express One Zone: Amazon S3 Express One Zone is the fastest and lowest-latency storage class in Amazon S3, designed for workloads that need microsecond-level latency

Order moving: Standard → StandardIA → Intelligent tiering → One zone-IA → Glacier Instant retrieval →Glacier Flexible retrieval → Glacier Deep Archive

Moving objects can be automated using a Lifecycle Rules

Transition Actions - move after x days Expiration actions - object delete after x days Can be used to delete versions of files

Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) delete on the Amazon S3 bucket

S3 analytics: help you decide when to transition object in what storage class

Requester pays bucket- requester will pay to get data from bucket

S3 events notification example: S3 → SNS bucket arn in SNS policy S3 → SQS bucket arn in SQS policy S3 → LAMBDA bucket arn in lambda invoke policy

Anything else from eventbridge

Storage lens: Analyse optimise storage across AWS Organization → Default dashboard

Http cant talk to S3 if you enable aws:securetransport : false

Access point: S3 access point VPC Origin EC2 + VPC ENDPOINT (need to allow s3 + access point vpc) →ACCESS point VPC (GATEWAY INTERFERENCE) → S3 bucket

S3 OBJECT Lambda access point:

When you use lambda to change the original object from s3 S3 → LAMBDA → s3 object Lambda access point → team x
